create_gpt_neo_config: create a GPTNeoConfig instance with custom model parameters like hidden_size and num_layers
validate_gpt_neo_config: validate that GPTNeoConfig attention_layers length matches num_layers
expand_attention_types: expand GPTNeoConfig attention_types into a flat list of per-layer attention types
custom_unfold_tensor: run a custom torch.Tensor.unfold implementation for ONNX export compatibility
custom_get_block_length: compute block length and number of blocks for GPTNeo local attention window
